definitions.meaning: (gen. pronounced with the vowel 'ಅ') the forty eighth letter of Kannaḍa alphabet and the thirty fourth consonant.
(math.) a symbol for the number nine.
the letter or the sound of 'ಳ' (usu. pronounced with the vowel 'ಅ'.
a woman whose body is slender and delicate.
(mus.) in Karnāṭaka system, the sixty third of the seventy two main modes.
any plant having a long, slender stem that trails or creeps on the ground or climbs by winding itself about a support or holding fast with tendrils or claspers; a vine; a creeper.
(gen. ) a tender plant or tender part of a plant.
a branch of a tree, shrub, etc.
the grass Setaria italica ( = Panicum italicum) of Poaceae family.
another grass Panicum dactylon of the same family.
the vine Cardiospermum halicacabum of Sapindaceae family; heart pea.
the plant Capparis brevispina of Capparaceae family.
the plant Trigonella corniculata of Papilionaceae family.
(jain.) a very long period (as an age or era).
(dance.) the posture in which one arm is stretched straight and the hand is drooped loosely(?).
a word that ends with the sound 'ಳ'.
the fact of a word ending with the sound 'ಳ'.
